groups.personalDataAccess.description: NB: Under Art. 4(1)(1) of the GDPR, personal data means any information about an identified or identifiable person, directly or indirectly, by reference to an identifier (e.g., a name, identification number, location data, online identifier) or one or more factors specific to their physical, physiological, genetic, mental, economic, cultural, or social identity. Therefore, personal data includes not only data that directly identifies an individual but also data that can be linked to an individual only indirectly through third parties (e.g., vehicle license plate number, employee number, or other alphanumeric code assigned by a third party).
groups.personalDataAccess.label: Do you access personal data?
groups.personalDataTypes.label: Select the type(s) of personal data you will access through this E-Service, based on the definitions in Art. 4(1), (13), (14), and (15) of the GDPR.
groups.purposeOfAccess.description: NB: Under Art. 5(1)(b) of the GDPR (purpose limitation principle), your purposes must be specific, explicit, and legitimate. Any data obtained may only be processed in ways that are compatible with those stated purposes. If you have more than one purpose, you MUST complete a separate declaration for each one.
groups.purposeOfAccess.label: What is the purpose of your access to the data provided by this E-Service?
